checks.claim: Spanish inheritance and gift tax covers acquisitions by inheritance or legacy, donations and certain life-insurance benefits to individuals
Inheritance and gift tax analysis is territorial and may depend on autonomous-community and foral rules, so jurisdiction must be checked per case
Spanish wealth tax is levied on the net wealth of individuals and territorial/foral rules can affect the applicable treatment
The Civil Code defines the legítima as the portion of the estate that the testator cannot freely dispose of because it is reserved to forced heirs, subject to applicable civil-law territory
Transfers of assets can generate personal-income-tax capital gains or losses and statutory exemptions such as main-residence reinvestment must be checked against the current facts and law
Patrimonial planning necessarily crosses tax, civil-law, financial, real-estate, succession and company domains, so no single static rule may bypass those specialist validations

limitations: This validates suitability as a maintained patrimonial decision-support source, not every sentence or personal scenario exhaustively.
Tax rates, allowances, regional/foral benefits, valuations, civil-law territory, succession facts and cross-border consequences must be checked live per case.
Wills, signatures, filings, legal representation, tax submissions, investment execution and reserved professional acts remain subject to legal/human gates where applicable.
